name: robots/itheima1__mcp_robot
title: itheima1 mcp_robot six-servo arm (ServoControllerStandalone)
intro: itheima1 mcp_robot six-servo arm (ServoControllerStandalone), adapted from itheima1/mcp_robot. It reads `joint_positions`; runs `move_joints`, `home`, `disable_all_torque` and `enable_all_torque`. `move_joints`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
